name: Brock K. Phillips Sr.
headline: Nuvara founder · U.S. Army veteran · Systems and workflow builder
professionalSummary: Founder of Nuvara and U.S. Army veteran with a background in counterintelligence, federal benefits review, equipment maintenance, and youth programs. I bring evidence analysis, clear documentation, and operational judgment to human-directed AI projects, technical systems, and practical learning tools. I direct product development and use AI assistance for coding, drafting, analysis, and testing, with human review and documented checks.

experience.title: Founder and Principal
highlights: Translate practical needs into AI-assisted web systems, documented workflows, and learning tools.
Direct product scope, implementation, technical documentation, and quality review while maintaining human control over consequential decisions.
Organize source evidence, operating procedures, and project status so completed work, prototypes, and remaining dependencies are clear.

experience.title: Veterans Service Representative
highlights: Review federal benefits evidence, proposed actions, and notices for technical accuracy, completeness, and procedural compliance.
Reconcile records, identify conflicting or missing information, and document corrective guidance needed to resolve deficiencies.
Maintain organized case documentation and protect confidential information during review and quality oversight.

experience.title: Youth Program Assistant / Youth Sports and Fitness Specialist
highlights: Coordinated sports, fitness, and youth activities, including schedules, equipment, program records, and accountability procedures.
Monitored safety practices and documented program requirements for supervisory review.
Worked with families and program staff to provide clear service and apply program standards consistently.

experience.title: Sergeant · Counterintelligence and Utilities Equipment Repair
highlights: Served 3 years and 1 month in counterintelligence; earlier utilities equipment repair specialty totaled 13 years and 1 month.
Conducted investigative and analytical inquiries, reconciled information from multiple sources, and prepared written reports and briefings.
Supported equipment maintenance, safety, inventory, operations, and personnel training.
